uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3693-4659-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {2}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Walking Ballista resolves, entering with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

81-2021-2060-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, X-23 triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on X-23 and the other Mutant.
Repeat.
5231-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-5086-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2730-5237-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3649-5334-5940.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
3649-5334-5940.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability twice due to Roaming Throne.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying {1}{R}{R}, choosing its first mode and copying either of Etrata's triggers.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

38-1829-2173-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3609-6881--127.easyPrerequisites: Other creatures you control have power 3 or greater.
3609-6881--127.description:
Activate a Spacecraft's station ability by tapping a creature you control, putting a number of charge counters on the Spacecraft equal to the creature's power.
If necessary, repeat step 1 until the Spacecraft has three or more charge counters on it.
Activate Moxite Refinery by paying {2}, tapping it and removing three charge counters from the Spacecraft, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
3609-6881--127.notes: You can move as many charge counters from the Spacecraft to Magistrate's Scepter. If you move more than three, you may be able to forego steps 1-3 during some turns.

147-2292-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-2292-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-2561-3129-4559.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Metalwork Colossus, creating two Food tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Foods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3143-5696-6176.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5696-6176.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Undergrowth Champion trigger.
Resolve the Undergrowth Champion trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

586-2350-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

784-3327-3719-4615.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo and Silas Renn are your commanders.
You have sacrificed a number of artifacts and/or creatures this turn equal to the number of times you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game minus four.
784-3327-3719-4615.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{R}.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When the Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Ruthless Technomancer and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Activate the Ruthless Technomancer token by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 8.

1167-2580-5049.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
As the opponent, activate Lethal Vapors by paying {0} an arbitrarily large number of times, causing that opponent to skip that many turns.

1495-2265-2744-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1495-2265-2744-3828.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.
During the next player's turn, you may remove all of the +1/+1 counters from Triskelion to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

205-804.description:
Cast Sakashima by paying {2}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Azor.
Sakashima enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Activate Sakashima by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Sakashima triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

2742-3430-4289.notablePrerequisites: Duergar Mine-Captain does not have summoning sickness.
2742-3430-4289.description:
Declare Duergar Mine-Captain as an attacker.
Activate Duergar Mine-Captain by paying {1}{R/W} and untapping it, causing all attacking creatures to gain +1/+0 until end of turn.
Activate Duergar Mine-Captain by tapping it, adding three mana of {R} or {W}.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2638-5233.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2638-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1651-4216-4682.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1651-4216-4682.description:
Activate Folio of Fancies's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it, causing each player to draw two cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers, creating a Treasure token for each player who can't pay {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Folio of Fancies.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding four mana of any colors.
Repeat.

411-2510-4720-4893.notablePrerequisites: Any creature exiled by Semblance Anvil.
411-2510-4720-4893.description:
Pay {R} to return Grinning Ignus to your hand, adding {R}{C}{C}.
Cast Grinning Ignus for {R}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast for {C} to add {R} leaving you where you started with with an additional {1}.
Repeat for infinite mana.

950-3078-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Fatestitcher.
950-3078-3525.description:
Activate Soldevi Excavations by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Soldevi Excavations.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
